Name: CF - Zaoux's Pride Flag Banners
Author: zaoux
Description:
[center][size=1][i]- Apologies in advance, this is my very first mod/post here! -[/i][/size]

Basic Mod that adds [s]20[/s] [i]44![/i] different Pride flags to your catalogue using Custom Furniture!

[b]- UPDATE - VERSION 2.O -[/b]
[i]Updated assets on Modpage! Enjoy the non-blurry cover photo!
Aside from the first three rainbow flags, alphabetised all the flags!
Added multiple new flags!
Added a reference image to the mod file itself for easy comparison![/i]

[i][b]As Custom Furniture is currently broken for 1.6, I cannot confirm that these
are working in game. However, all the coding is the same and I went over
it probably about a million times!
Because of that, however, I'll be working on a version for Alternative Textures!
So keep an eye out!
I wanted to release this for you all now as the assets are done,
I just need to... learn the coding for a new mod lol


[/b][/i][size=4]Now with an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23959/]Alternative Textures version![/url]﻿
Please check this one out as this one is tested and 1.6 compatible!
[/size]

[b]- UPDATE - VERSION 1.3 -
[/b][i]Fixed a visual issue with the flags
Fixed the incorrect description on the newest flag[/i]

[b]- UPDATE - VERSION 1.2 -[/b]
[i]Changed the Labrys Lesbian flag to the first Butch Lesbian Flag design
because of the history of the problematic creator
Fixed a coding issue where all the new flags were the Neutrois flag[/i]

[b]- UPDATE - VERSION 1.1 -[/b]
[i]Added 17 new pride flags! 7 gender-specific pride flags,
another Polyamorous pride flag, and every Demi under the sun!
Also fixed a code problem, thanks for pointing that out for me!
[/i]
[b]~ Installation ~[/b]
- Unzip in your mods folder and run the game
(Recommended to have the Catalogue from Robin's Shop)[/center]
